# Contributing Guidelines

**Notice: External contributions are closed.**

This public repository exists exclusively to deploy and host the official landing page for **BodyRush** (https://bodyrush.app) via GitHub Pages.

- **No Pull Requests**: We do not accept pull requests, patches, or external code contributions.
- **No Issues**: For user support, press inquiries, or feedback, please contact us directly at [xlarrodeapp+bodyrush@gmail.com](mailto:xlarrodeapp+bodyrush@gmail.com) instead of opening GitHub issues.
- **Proprietary Assets**: All visual branding, 3D artwork, characters, stickers, and text are proprietary and protected under copyright law.

Thank you for your interest in BodyRush!
